score-tier-blue.note: The Score-tier B band uses the info-blue family from shared/lib/classification/grades.ts. Grade badges only, never state chips or controls.

display.purpose: Route/page titles + top-nav wordmark. Bricolage Grotesque ink-trap, 800.

headline.purpose: Section titles (Market Pulse, Stablecoin Overview). Bricolage 700.

title.purpose: Card and sub-section headings. System sans 600.

body.purpose: UI text and prose. System sans 400, 14px base.

numeric.purpose: Every digit-bearing cell. JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums slashed-zero.

label.purpose: Sentence-case section, card and field labels. System sans 600, normal tracking.

eyebrow.purpose: At most one short uppercase route/hero eyebrow. System sans 600, 0.08em tracking.

shadows.name: elevation-rest
shadows.purpose: Applied on card hover only, paired with a -2px lift. Never at rest.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Decelerating standard easing — no bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Flat Card
components.description: The canonical surface. Fill + 1px hairline, no resting shadow; lifts on hover.
components.html:
Market cohorts

Peg health

Tracked stablecoins within band.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card-bg, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--card-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: none; padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.2); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 6%), 0 8px 20px oklch(0 0 0 / 4%); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-kicker { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; color: oklch(0.52 0.007 260); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.4 0.009 260); }

components.name: Hero Metric
components.description: The headline market figure in neutral ink; semantic state is the only reason to color a figure.
components.css: .ds-hero-metric { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .ds-hero-metric-label { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.52 0.007 260); } .ds-hero-metric-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; font-size: 2.45rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

components.name: Numeric Cell
components.description: Right-aligned tabular figure used in every data column.
components.css: .ds-numeric { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

components.name: Control Pill (default + active)
components.description: Compact data controls. Active uses elevated-neutral fill, primary text and a hairline ring, never solid ink or frost-blue.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control-pill-border, oklch(0.87 0.01 255 / 0.78)); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--control-pill-bg, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.78)); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.4 0.009 260); cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-pill:hover { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); background: oklch(0.96 0.004 255); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface-base, oklch(0.985 0 0)), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.64 0.18 248 / 0.6); } .ds-pill-active { background: var(--control-pill-active-bg, oklch(0.91 0.005 260)); color: var(--control-pill-active-text, oklch(0.145 0 0)); border-color: var(--control-pill-active-ring, oklch(0.19 0.01 255 / 0.3)); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Top Nav
components.description: Global frosted top bar (≥lg), neutral active menu and full-width content. Menu contents belong to src/lib/nav-config.ts.
components.html: PharosOverview Markets Risk Analyze Learn ReferenceSearch ⌘K
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.008 255 / 0.7); background: oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-nav-links { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.52 0.007 260); align-items: center; } .ds-nav-on { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); background: oklch(0.95 0.004 260); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-search { margin-left: auto; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: oklch(0.52 0.007 260); padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.87 0.01 255 / 0.7); border-radius: 8px; }
